title: Retaining walls around a rural tennis court: notice-to-fix scope (Parkhurst, Auckland)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Notice to fix issued for building work to the south and west sections of a retaining wall around a proposed tennis court on a 3.2 ha rural property near Kaipara Harbour.
Applicants argued that the wall was exempt under clause 41 of Schedule 1 (retaining walls, exemption 20).
Notice described a retaining wall about 1.5 m high supporting slope surcharge and a driveway.
